args.action_description: FRAME FORMAT160x160 source, fixed root80,136, same canvas and character size every frame. Soldier begins ALREADY flat on his belly as shown. A complete smooth military belly-crawl cycle while aiming rifle along his existing facing. Alternate left elbow pulling and right knee pushing, then other elbow and knee; hips and chest remain on floor at the SAME LOW height. Body advances in place by limb action, torso never rises to crouch/kneel/stand. Rifle stays steady and does NOT fire. No muzzle flash or projectiles. The head, armor, legs and fixed red-black palette match the supplied prone pose exactly. Same fixed top-down camera. End at exact initial belly-down pose for a seamless loop.
